narrative.headline: The late coffees are the cost here: three of them after 3:50 PM.
paragraphs: Coffee was in frame at 3:53, 4:00 and 4:06 PM, late enough to cut into deep sleep tonight. About 11 minutes of screen in three blocks, and three trips outside that added up to about 4 minutes. The rice bowl came back three times and still counts toward the Mediterranean pattern.
suggestions: No more caffeine today. Water or herbal tea from here.
Walk outside for 15 minutes before the light goes.

narrative.headline: Two more coffees, and the screen came back after every break.
paragraphs: Screen time came in four short blocks, about 7 minutes, each starting within a minute or two of coming back in. Outdoors twice, close to 4 minutes. Coffee was in frame twice and alcohol three times.
suggestions: Leave the phone inside the next time you step out.
narrative.spoken: Two more coffees, and the screen came back after every break.

narrative.headline: A screen-heavy start, broken by two short stretches outside.
paragraphs: About 8 minutes of sustained screen in three blocks, with two trips outdoors of about 3 minutes in all. Coffee was in frame twice and alcohol twice. The rice bowl counts toward the Mediterranean pattern.
suggestions: Hold the next coffee until tomorrow morning.
